93acd72941d04520:
Documentation displayed to the administrator of a Phabricator instance.

$1 is the URL https://we.phorge.it/book/phorge/article/managing_caches/

Note that Phabricator uses [https://we.phorge.it/book/phorge/article/remarkup/ Remarkup] to render text instead of wikitext, which uses slightly different syntax. This means that the URLs inside square brackets are correct as is and should not be corrected. And of course, URLs shouldn't be translated generally unless a version of the website https://pygments.org/ exists in your language.
